message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The doctor recognized the early-preterm newborn context and gave extensive red-flag guidance for bilious/bloody/projectile vomiting, temperature, respiratory distress, cyanosis, and poor responsiveness. These are minor/moderate in-chain errors rather than a serious red-flag delay, so the deterministic cap is grade 2 despite some strong anxiety-adapted
